old_method = '''    @classmethod
    def from_string(cls, tb_str):
        """Parse a traceback and exception from the text *tb_str*. This text
        is expected to have been decoded, otherwise it will be
        interpreted as UTF-8.

        This method does not search a larger body of text for
        tracebacks. If the first line of the text passed does not
        match one of the known patterns, a :exc:`ValueError` will be
        raised. This method will ignore trailing text after the end of
        the first traceback.

        Args:
            tb_str (str): The traceback text (:class:`unicode` or UTF-8 bytes)
        """
        if not isinstance(tb_str, str):
            tb_str = tb_str.decode('utf-8')
        tb_lines = tb_str.lstrip().splitlines()

        # First off, handle some ignored exceptions. These can be the
        # result of exceptions raised by __del__ during garbage
        # collection
        while tb_lines:
            cl = tb_lines[-1]
            if cl.startswith('Exception ') and cl.endswith('ignored'):
                tb_lines.pop()
            else:
                break
        if tb_lines and tb_lines[0].strip() == 'Traceback (most recent call last):':
            start_line = 1
            frame_re = _frame_re
        elif len(tb_lines) > 1 and tb_lines[-2].lstrip().startswith('^'):
            # This is to handle the slight formatting difference
            # associated with SyntaxErrors, which also don't really
            # have tracebacks
            start_line = 0
            frame_re = _se_frame_re
        else:
            raise ValueError('unrecognized traceback string format')

        # Use partition to separate frame lines from non-frame lines.
        # Each item goes to the first matching predicate; everything else
        # goes into the final unmatched bucket.
        content_lines = tb_lines[start_line:]
        frame_pred = lambda l: bool(frame_re.match(l.strip()))
        frame_lines, other_lines = partition(content_lines, [frame_pred])

        # Now parse frames from frame_lines, handling source lines and underlines
        frames = []
        other_idx = 0
        num_other = len(other_lines)

        def get_other(idx):
            if idx < num_other:
                return other_lines[idx]
            return None

        for i, fl in enumerate(frame_lines):
            stripped = fl.strip()
            frame_match = frame_re.match(stripped)
            frame_dict = frame_match.groupdict()

            # Check if the next "other" line is an indented source line
            next_other = get_other(other_idx)
            if next_other is not None and next_other.startswith(' ') and not frame_re.match(next_other.strip()):
                frame_dict['source_line'] = next_other.strip()
                other_idx += 1
            else:
                frame_dict['source_line'] = ''

            # Check for underline anchor
            next_other = get_other(other_idx)
            if next_other is not None and _underline_re.match(next_other):
                other_idx += 1

            frames.append(frame_dict)

        # Everything remaining in other_lines is the exception line(s)
        try:
            exc_parts = other_lines[other_idx:]
            exc_line = '\\n'.join(exc_parts)
            exc_type, _, exc_msg = exc_line.partition(': ')
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_msg = '', ''

        return cls(exc_type, exc_msg, frames)'''

new_method = '''    @classmethod
    def from_string(cls, tb_str):
        """Parse a traceback and exception from the text *tb_str*. This text
        is expected to have been decoded, otherwise it will be
        interpreted as UTF-8.

        This method does not search a larger body of text for
        tracebacks. If the first line of the text passed does not
        match one of the known patterns, a :exc:`ValueError` will be
        raised. This method will ignore trailing text after the end of
        the first traceback.

        Args:
            tb_str (str): The traceback text (:class:`unicode` or UTF-8 bytes)
        """
        if not isinstance(tb_str, str):
            tb_str = tb_str.decode('utf-8')
        tb_lines = tb_str.lstrip().splitlines()

        # First off, handle some ignored exceptions. These can be the
        # result of exceptions raised by __del__ during garbage
        # collection
        while tb_lines:
            cl = tb_lines[-1]
            if cl.startswith('Exception ') and cl.endswith('ignored'):
                tb_lines.pop()
            else:
                break
        if tb_lines and tb_lines[0].strip() == 'Traceback (most recent call last):':
            start_line = 1
            frame_re = _frame_re
        elif len(tb_lines) > 1 and tb_lines[-2].lstrip().startswith('^'):
            # This is to handle the slight formatting difference
            # associated with SyntaxErrors, which also don't really
            # have tracebacks
            start_line = 0
            frame_re = _se_frame_re
        else:
            raise ValueError('unrecognized traceback string format')

        # Use partition to classify content lines into frame lines vs.
        # non-frame lines. Items go to the first matching predicate;
        # unmatched items fall into the final bucket.
        content_lines = tb_lines[start_line:]
        frame_pred = lambda l: bool(frame_re.match(l.strip()))
        matched, unmatched = partition(content_lines, [frame_pred])

        # Build frames by walking through matched lines in order,
        # pulling source/anchor lines from unmatched as needed.
        frames = []
        unmatched_idx = 0
        num_unmatched = len(unmatched)

        def _get_unmatched(idx):
            if idx < num_unmatched:
                return unmatched[idx]
            return None

        for fl in matched:
            stripped = fl.strip()
            fm = frame_re.match(stripped)
            fd = fm.groupdict()

            # Look ahead in unmatched for a source line (indented, non-frame)
            nxt = _get_unmatched(unmatched_idx)
            if nxt is not None and nxt.startswith(' ') and not frame_re.match(nxt.strip()):
                fd['source_line'] = nxt.strip()
                unmatched_idx += 1
            else:
                fd['source_line'] = ''

            # Skip any underline anchor following this frame
            nxt = _get_unmatched(unmatched_idx)
            if nxt is not None and _underline_re.match(nxt):
                unmatched_idx += 1

            frames.append(fd)

        # Remaining unmatched lines form the exception info
        try:
            exc_parts = unmatched[unmatched_idx:]
            exc_line = '\\n'.join(exc_parts)
            exc_type, _, exc_msg = exc_line.partition(': ')
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_msg = '', ''

        return cls(exc_type, exc_msg, frames)'''

r = await world.call('repo.edit_file', path='boltons/tbutils.py', old_string=old_method, new_string=new_method)
print(r['ok'], r.get('content', '')[:200])
